| description = 

These can be quadded at level 54 as a druid. I started with Ally faction and i had to harmony the crap out of the camps to single pull at this level. The rule of thumb here from what i can tell is, If you can quad a pack of wyvern and be left with at least half of your mana pool you should be able to do these guys. 

[EDIT ''Creatures'': You'll need a '''minimum of 2600 mana''' as a Druid.  A resist or partial resist can really mess things up if you're just barely at 2600. ({{:Elder Spiritist's Vambraces}}) can help significantly with finishing off mobs.]  

[I was able to get these done at 54 with approx 2226 mana - the key is to take med breaks between each cast. Run about twice the length of the spell range, and then med until you're in range. This will get you about where you need to be, but POTG+Form of the Howler makes it so you need minimal med breaks, even better if you have C2 and gift of brilliance.]

The key here is the pull. You mess that up and you are as good as dead, these run fast (faster than SoW) and hit fast and if you get stunned that could be the end of it. Also, obviously, don't kite them near the camps.

| A Druids Notes = 

* I spent all of level 59 quading these Othmir Warriors, and just wanted to share my experience on their loot. I killed somewhere between 500-600 Othmir, I didn't keep that close of track, so for the sake of calculating these numbers lets meet in the middle and say I killed 550.

The individual armor and gem drop percentages are already listed above, and are pretty close to what I experienced as well, so I'll just list some additional aggregate information.
'''Chance of any armor''' - 12.36% (68 total pieces looted on 550 kills)
'''Chance of any gem''' - 25.45% (140 gems looted on 550 kills)
'''Othmir Fur''' - 16% (88 fur looted on 550 kills)
The saleable gems to players are Flawed Topaz, Flawed Emerald, Flawed Sea Sapphire, Jaundice Gem, Chipped Onyx Sapphire, Nephrite. The rest of the vendor trash gems I was able to sell to merchants for 2,585pp.
